1: // Simple Cosmic Courier game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Game state
12:   const state = {
13:     ship: { x: width / 2, y: height - 60, radius: 15, hp: 3, speed: 3 },
14:     keys: {},
15:     asteroids: [],
16:     timer: 30, // seconds to deliver
17:     lastTime: 0,
18:     elapsed: 0,
19:     delivered: false,
20:   };
21: 
22:   // Input handling
23:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (state.keys[e.key] = true));
24:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (state.keys[e.key] = false));
25: 
26:   function spawnAsteroid() {
27:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
28:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size * 2) + size;
29:     const y = -size;
30:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
31:     state.asteroids.push({ x, y, size, speed });
32:   }
33: 
34:   function update(dt) {
35:     // timer
36:     state.elapsed += dt;
37:     if (state.elapsed >= 1) {
38:       state.timer -= 1;
39:       state.elapsed = 0;
40:     }
41:     if (state.timer <= 0) state.ship.hp = 0; // lose by timeout
42: 
43:     // ship movement (arrow keys or WASD)
44:     const s = state.ship;
45:     if (state.keys['ArrowLeft'] || state.keys['a']) s.x -= s.speed;
46:     if (state.keys['ArrowRight'] || state.keys['d']) s.x += s.speed;
47:     if (state.keys['ArrowUp'] || state.keys['w']) s.y -= s.speed;
48:     if (state.keys['ArrowDown'] || state.keys['s']) s.y += s.speed;
49:     // clamp
50:     s.x = Math.max(s.radius, Math.min(width - s.radius, s.x));
51:     s.y = Math.max(s.radius, Math.min(height - s.radius, s.y));
52: 
53:     // asteroids movement
54:     for (const a of state.asteroids) {
55:       a.y += a.speed;
56:     }
57:     // remove off‑screen
58:     state.asteroids = state.asteroids.filter(a => a.y - a.size < height);
59:     // spawn new occasionally
60:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
61: 
62:     // collision detection
63:     for (const a of state.asteroids) {
64:       const dx = a.x - s.x;
65:       const dy = a.y - s.y;
66:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
67:       if (dist < a.size + s.radius) {
68:         s.hp -= 1;
69:         a.size = 0; // destroy asteroid
70:       }
71:     }
72:     // simple win: survive until timer runs out with hp>0
73:     if (state.timer <= 0 && s.hp > 0) state.delivered = true;
74:   }
75: 
76:   function draw() {
77:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
78:     // ship
79:     const s = state.ship;
80:     ctx.fillStyle = s.hp > 0 ? '#0f0' : '#f00';
81:     ctx.beginPath();
82:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
83:     ctx.fill();
84:     // asteroids
85:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
86:     for (const a of state.asteroids) {
87:       ctx.beginPath();
88:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
89:       ctx.fill();
90:     }
91:     // HUD
92:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
93:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
94:     ctx.fillText(`HP: ${s.hp}`, 10, 20);
95:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${state.timer}s`, 10, 40);
96:     if (state.delivered) {
97:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
98:       ctx.fillText('Package Delivered!', width / 2 - 70, height / 2);
99:     }
100:     if (s.hp <= 0) {
101:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f55';
102:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 40, height / 2);
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   function loop(timestamp) {
107:     const dt = (timestamp - state.lastTime) / 1000;
108:     state.lastTime = timestamp;
109:     if (state.ship.hp > 0 && !state.delivered) {
110:       update(dt);
111:       draw();
112:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
113:     } else {
114:       draw(); // final frame
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
119: })();
